dialogues.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
dialogues.text: Well, if it isn't Dehya's friend! So you're my boss this time?

choices.text: I'm looking forward to working with you!

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: You took the words right out of my mouth! However, you should be aware that due to certain personal habits... I might make some small mistakes.

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: Like when playing the villain, I might get a bit too into it and end up scaring the guests... I've been known to comfort children into tears.

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: Please forgive me if something like that ends up happening!

choices.text: I feel like we've met before...

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: You're famous! And aside from that, you're often out and about. I've seen you quite a few times now, but you probably haven't noticed me before.

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: There was this one time — before I knew you were Dehya's friend — where we even went toe to toe. You gave me a solid beating, as I recall. Perhaps I managed to land a small scratch or two...

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: If so, I must apologize. Anyway, it's all water under the bridge now.

response.speaker: Uncle Scimitar
response.text: Alright, I'll work hard to make that happen!
